title: Rory and the Sleepy Cedar Grove
verses:
The sun drifted down past the edge of the hill,
The breeze in the branches was quiet and still.
And Rory walked softly through carpets of green,
To visit the coziest place ever seen.

Then Tilly arrived with a bundle of fern,
To make a soft bed at the sleepy trail's turn.
And Benny leaned down with a slow, heavy sigh,
While stars started blinking up high in the sky.

Now Ricky had bounded through bushes all day,
But stopped with a yawn as he finished his play.
High over the cedars swept Nia in flight,
To welcome the peace of the velvety night.

Then Psittaco nestled in leaves on a bough,
And chirped a sweet tune that was delicate now.
A warm little twinkle of fireflies glowed,
Above the soft moss of the slumbering road.

Now Rory curled down in the ferns at the base,
With all of his friends in their favorite place.
The shadows grew long as the dusk turned to deep,
And Benny hummed low as they drifted to sleep.

The moon shed a blanket of silvery light,
To wish the calm forest a restful goodnight.
Their eyelids grew heavy, their breathing fell slow,
In dreams where the sleepy companions would go.
